newsitem.title: ROMANIA: RADIO ROMANIA AFTERNOON HEADLINES AT 1 PM.
newsitem.headline: RADIO ROMANIA AFTERNOON HEADLINES AT 1 PM.

text.p: * King Michael travelled to Curtea de Arges to visit the tombs of his ancestors, King Ferdinand and Queen Maria.
Villagers greeted the ex-king on his way to Curtea de Arges.

* The restoration of the monarchy can only be decided by a referendum, National Peasant Party leader Ion Diaconescu told a news conference, saying that the referendum issue was not topical for his party.
* The government needs to focus on reform and social and moral health of Romanian society, Interior Minister Gavril Dejeu said.
Dejeu said sacked top police officials because they failed to fight against corruption.
* Romanian Defence Minister Victor Babiuc attended ceremony to create the army's first rapid reaction force.
